2: **Status: FINALIZED**

6: 
7: ## Product Overview
8: 
9: Kezza Agent Rewards is an invitation-only mobile-first referral platform for Kezza clinic agents. Agents refer patients, submit collected-payment claims, and earn reward points after authorized finance review. No self-registration. No client-side balance editing.
10: 
11: ---
12: 
13: ## Stack (Locked)
14: 
15: | Layer | Technology |
16: |---|---|
17: | Mobile | Expo SDK 57, React Native 0.86.3, Expo Router, TanStack Query v5, Zustand, Axios, Secure Store |
18: | Backend | Python 3.11+, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2, Alembic, PostgreSQL (`kezza_rewards_db`) |
19: | Admin | Next.js App Router, TypeScript, React |
20: | Auth | JWT access tokens (mobile: Secure Store) + rotated refresh sessions (admin: HTTP-only cookie) |
21:

23: 
24: ## Functional Requirements
25: 
26: ### FR-1: Identity & Invitation
27: - FR-1.1 Admin creates invitation tied to a branch + phone + agent_code (expires 72h)
28: - FR-1.2 Agent requests OTP for their mobile number
29: - FR-1.3 OTP verified → existing active user gets full session; invited user gets phone-verify token
30: - FR-1.4 Agent activates invite using phone-verify token + invitation code → creates User record → full session
31: - FR-1.5 Open self-registration is disabled
32: - FR-1.6 Refresh token rotation on every use; revoked on sign-out
33: 
34: ### FR-2: Patient Referral
35: - FR-2.1 Agent adds patient: name, phone (unique), service, branch attribution, note
36: - FR-2.2 Must display and confirm active approved consent text (version + timestamp stored)
37: - FR-2.3 Idempotency key prevents duplicate referral on retry
38: - FR-2.4 Referral status flow: new → contacted → in_progress → converted | not_converted | closed
39: - FR-2.5 Agent can only view/update their own referrals
40: - FR-2.6 Patient phone is unique across the system
41: 
42: ### FR-3: Payment Claims
43: - FR-3.1 Agent selects a referral, enters invoice number, invoice amount, collected amount, date, method, transaction ref
44: - FR-3.2 Invoice number unique per branch (normalized)
45: - FR-3.3 Multiple partial claims per invoice allowed; sum of reserved+approved ≤ invoice amount
46: - FR-3.4 Agent uploads receipt evidence (JPEG/PNG/PDF, max 8MB); stored outside public dir
47: - FR-3.5 Claim status: draft → submitted → under_review → needs_information → resubmitted → approved | rejected | reversed
48: - FR-3.6 Agent responds to needs_information with additional note → resubmitted
49: - FR-3.7 Agent cannot approve own claim
50: 
51: ### FR-4: Payment Review (Admin)
52: - FR-4.1 Branch reviewer: inspect claims in their branch scope, return for info, reject
53: - FR-4.2 Finance reviewer: approve with approved_amount_paise, return for info, reject
54: - FR-4.3 Self-approval denied (reviewer_id ≠ agent_id)
55: - FR-4.4 All decisions recorded in payment_decisions with reason + idempotency key
56: - FR-4.5 On approval: points credited to reward_ledger per active approved policy
57: 
58: ### FR-5: Reward Points & Cycles
59: - FR-5.1 Working policy: 1 pt per whole eligible rupee, 10 pts = ₹1 indicative
60: - FR-5.2 Three-month cycle, ₹1,00,000 threshold minimum
61: - FR-5.3 Points credited only after approved claim, never on pending
62: - FR-5.4 Ledger append-only: credit, reversal, expiry, settlement, adjustment entry_types
63: - FR-5.5 Cycle states: scheduled → open → closing → closed
64: - FR-5.6 Admin previews cycle before close; close action guarded by policy completion
65: - FR-5.7 Settlements generated on close; external payment ref recorded after payout
66: 
67: ### FR-6: Mobile Screens (Complete States)
68: Every screen must have: loading, error/retry, empty, and populated states.
69: 
70: | Screen | Must Have |
71: |---|---|
72: | Login | Phone input + OTP request; dev_code display in dev mode |
73: | OTP Verify | 6-digit input, resend, error states |
74: | Activate | Full name, invitation code entry, validation |
75: | Home/Overview | Stats row, agent code card, cycle progress bar, quick actions, recent referrals |
76: | Patients tab | Searchable list, status filter, pull-to-refresh |
77: | Referral detail | Status + history, linked claims, update status action |
78: | Add patient | Consent display + confirm checkbox, all fields validated |
79: | Payments tab | Claims list with status badges, pull-to-refresh |
80: | Payment claim detail | Evidence upload, reviewer feedback, respond action |
81: | Add payment | Referral picker, invoice fields, amount validation |
82: | Wallet/Rewards | Points balance, ledger list, cycle progress, indicative value |
83: | Profile | Agent info, branch, sign-out, links to secondary screens |
84: | Notifications | List with mark-read, unread count badge |
85: | Branches | Branch directory with phone/maps links |
86: | Feedback | Category, message, rating, contact permission |
87: | Policies | Active legal docs, acceptance recording |
88: 
89: ### FR-7: Admin Portal (All Panels Complete)
90: | Panel | Required Operations |
91: |---|---|
92: | Overview | Operational counts, pending queues by branch |
93: | Agents | Create invitation, list agents, suspend/reactivate |
94: | Payment Review | Inspect claim + evidence, approve/return/reject with reason |
95: | Rewards & Cycles | Policy CRUD, cycle create/preview/close, settlement review |
96: | Branches & Services | Branch CRUD, service catalog, branch-change decisions |
97: | Feedback | View + respond to agent feedback |
98: | Documents & Audit | Legal doc versioning, app releases, audit log search |
99: 
100: ### FR-8: Non-Functional
101: - FR-8.1 All money stored as integer paise
102: - FR-8.2 Audit log on every sensitive action (actor, action, entity, before/after JSON)
103: - FR-8.3 JWT expiry 15min access / 7-day refresh session
104: - FR-8.4 OTP: 6 digits, 10-minute expiry, max 5 attempts, rate-limited by phone+IP
105: - FR-8.5 TypeScript strict, no `any`; Python typed with Pydantic v2
106: - FR-8.6 DB: `kezza_rewards_db` only; health endpoint rejects wrong DB name
107: - FR-8.7 Receipt files: private storage, served only after auth check
108: - FR-8.8 CORS: only configured origins
109: 
110: ---
111: 
112: ## Out of Scope (MVP)
113: - Recruitment commissions (disabled)
114: - Push notifications (in-app only)
115: - SMS provider integration (mock OTP in dev; placeholder for prod)
116: - Google OAuth (schema ready, not wired in MVP)
117: - Production receipt storage (local filesystem in dev)
118: - Multi-currency or non-INR support

291:         if not payload.reason or len(payload.reason.strip()) < 5:

315:                 or policy.threshold_mode == "unselected" or policy.late_approval_mode == "unselected"):

319:         late = now >= cycle.ends_at

321:             raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This policy requires late payment claims to be rejected")
322:         if cycle.status == "scheduled" and now < cycle.ends_at:
323:             cycle.status = "open"

325:         payment.status = "approved"
326:         payment.review_reason = payload.reason.strip()

328:         payment.decided_at = now

336:                body=f"Claim {payment.request_ref} has been approved. Your wallet shows any points awarded.",
337:                entity_type="payment_request", entity_id=payment.id)
338:     elif payload.decision == "request_information":

340:             raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This claim cannot be returned for information")
341:         if not payload.reason or len(payload.reason.strip()) < 5:

343:         payment.status = "needs_information"
344:         payment.review_reason = payload.reason.strip()
345:         payment.updated_at = now

348:                body=f"Claim {payment.request_ref} needs information. Open the claim to review the request.",
349:                entity_type="payment_request", entity_id=payment.id)
350:     elif payload.decision == "reject":
351:         if payment.status not in {"submitted", "under_review", "resubmitted"}:
352:             raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This claim cannot be rejected in its current status")
353:         if not payload.reason or len(payload.reason.strip()) < 5:
